title: Leaks at threads due to gasket issue. Fix that, & its a pretty good bottle
text:
Leaks at threads due to gasket issue. Fix that, & its a pretty good bottle. Bad outweighs the good. First the good:

At first glance, I loved this bottle. I have several water bottles for various needs. Some go with me through the day, one or two for working out (I go through a lot of water, especially in VR headsets), and usually one that just sits on the counter (so I take a sip whenever pass by). This bottle appealed to me because of:
-- The lip spout. It has a good mouth feel with good draw. I can get a decent mouthful of water without effort, can keep chugging as needed.
--The straw can be popped out if you prefer to knock it back and drink it that way.
--BPA free. Says so on the bottom of the bottle
--Top rack dishwasher safe. Says so on bottom of bottle.
--The silicone hand grip is comfortable, and effective (though see note below).
--The ability to lock the flip top cap is nice, albeit a little hard to do. Takes a little muscle at first.
--Built in loop makes it easy to grab with a finger, possibly could be attached to a bag with a carabiner.
--(not good or bad, just adding my thought on color) I'd recommend a color other than gray if you dont want your water to appear to look dirty. It is just a perfect color gray to make the water look hazy. Might not bother anyone else, but I do a double take when I walk into a room with this in it. Hasn't stopped me from using it.

Overall, if that was the extent of my observations, I would recommend it. BUT, two (three) things..

1. It is a challenge to get mouth port to line up for left or right handed use. I am not about to spend any amount of time to get the port to line up in such a way that I can drink from AND be able to hold it. I dont care of the grip in on left side or right side, but it doesnt just line up. I dont have that problem with other bottles.

2. Worst offender: it LEAKS. Boo, hiss. I deduced it is because of the gasket. It pops out easily. In the short time I have had it, the bottle went from working well (enough) to gasket comes off into the bottle, to not being able to get the gasket situated well enough to keep it from leaking. Likely will be fine if it never tips over. So for me, I can use this fine at home when I just want to take a few gulps. Use the straw because tipping this upright will just make it leak. It doesnt leak at the mouth port, it leaks at the threads where cap meets the bottle because of the faulty gasket. Fix that, and it is a pretty good bottle.

(3...kinda) I can't tell if the handle is pass through or not. It definitely holds some water. I haven't yet tried to shove anything down through (awkward angle). I'm thinking it might be solid, but has a small shelf in the handle that collects water. Not a big deal one way or another, but it will be a spot to make sure to get in to clean on occasion.

5 stars for ease of water draw (love love love the molded mouth port)
1 star.. because it leaks

I will use this, but it quickly disappointed me with its leaking.
